change: Planned: posters, audit in junior doctor induction, email reminders; e-documentation under consideration.

title: 802 Assessing the Below Knee Amputation Service in a London Major Trauma Centre: An Audit
topic: Below knee amputation pathway in orthoplastic trauma
standard: NICE guidelines for complex fractures and the Vascular Society guidance for major amputations
finding: 100% compliance with pre-operative MDT discussion, recording decision to amputate, and formal referral to amputee rehabilitation; average time to surgery after decision 1.75 days
change: Planned: a written pathway for lower limb amputations in the trust

detail.setting: Major trauma centre, orthoplastic patients (Royal London Hospital)

detail.intervention: Planned: a written pathway for lower limb amputations in the trust
detail.other_findings: Lower compliance with written counselling for families, naming a discharge co-ordinator pre-operatively and pain team review within 24 hours post-operatively.

title: 858 Post Operative Opioid Prescribing in Patients Undergoing Primary Elective Total Hip Replacement (THR): A Closed-Loop Clinical Audit
standard: NICE NG180 postoperative analgesia recommendations
finding: Baseline rates of regular oral opioid prescribing on D0 and time to first oral opioid (figures not given).
change: Printed NICE NG180 posters and face-to-face education on postoperative analgesia.

detail.setting: University College London Hospital, elective primary THR patients aged 60+

cycle1.result: Baseline rates of regular oral opioid prescribing on D0 and time to first oral opioid (figures not given).

detail.intervention: Printed NICE NG180 posters and face-to-face education on postoperative analgesia.

cycle2.result: 30% increase in purely regular oral opioid prescriptions on D0; 10% increase in first oral opioid within 2 hours for those on regular opioids.

detail.other_findings: 2–8 hour and >8 hour timings stayed similar; an electronic prescription order set is proposed.

title: 964 Intra-Operative Tourniquet Use in Lower Limb Orthopedic Surgery: A BOAST Audit
standard: BOAST: tourniquet pressure systolic plus 70-130 mmHg; ischaemic time less than 120 minutes
finding: Tourniquet use recorded 95.4% (62/66); total time 78.5% (51/66); inflation pressure 58.7% (37/62); 5 (7.6%) exceeded maximum time; mean time 82.4 min, mean pressure 265.7 mmHg.
change: Changes to the theatre documentation system; second cycle planned.
